game.title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Nintendo-exclusive, no native achievement list exists on either Switch or Switch 2. Several disputed dossier facts were deliberately excluded or left unquantified to avoid Rule 1/2 violations: exact collectible totals (Missile Expansions 46 vs. 48, Energy Tank/Shot Expansion/Green Energy Crystal totals) are contested across sources and never cited — full-collection trophies (Fully Loaded, Living Archive, Full Bloom) verify against the game's own confirmed percentage/meter readouts instead. The exact named list of missable Logbook scans is contested between guides, so no trophy names a specific missable scan; missability is instead flagged generally on the trophies that require pre-endgame collection, matching the dossier's confirmed hard point-of-no-return before the final Sylux fight. 'Fusion Mode'/Fusion Suit was not confirmed to exist in this title (likely conflated with Metroid: Samus Returns) and is excluded entirely. At the user's request, amiibo-unlocked content and the Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive Joy-Con 2 Mouse Mode feature are collected into a separate `dlc`-style bonus list ('Switch 2 & amiibo Extras') rather than the base list, since they require owning specific physical merchandise or Switch 2 hardware — per Rule 14 this bonus list never affects the base game's Platinum, which remains earnable by any player on either platform with no additional purchases.

trophies.name: First Contact
trophies.description: Defeat Aberax during the Prologue at the UTO Research Center.
trophies.verification: Aberax's defeat triggers the cutscene that teleports Samus to Viewros.

trophies.name: First Key
trophies.description: Obtain your first Master Teleportation Key.
trophies.verification: The Key appears in the quest-item inventory screen.

trophies.name: Guardian of the Garden
trophies.description: Defeat Carvex at the Garden of Remembrance in Fury Green.
trophies.verification: Carvex is defeated, and the path through Fury Green opens.

trophies.name: Rival Awakened
trophies.description: Defeat Sylux in your first encounter, in Volt Forge.
trophies.verification: The battle concludes with a cutscene and the path through Volt Forge continues.

trophies.name: Master of the Road
trophies.description: Complete the Vi-O-La Test Circuits and earn your Vi-O-La certification.
trophies.verification: Xelios grants the Vi-O-La certification and the Psychic Boots appear in the inventory screen.

trophies.name: Suit Up
trophies.description: Collect your first expansion item — a Missile Expansion, Energy Tank, Elemental Shot Expansion, or Psychic Power Bomb Expansion.
trophies.verification: The pickup confirmation plays and the item appears in the inventory/upgrades screen.

trophies.name: Signal Found
trophies.description: Activate your first Scout Bot.
trophies.verification: The Scout Bot marks nearby missing collectibles on the area map immediately after activation.

trophies.name: Circuit Breaker
trophies.description: Defeat Xelios in the depths of Volt Forge's Tower Three.
trophies.verification: Xelios is defeated, and the path through Volt Forge continues.

trophies.name: Frozen Sentinel
trophies.description: Defeat Keratos at the Quarantine Chamber in Ice Belt.
trophies.verification: Keratos is defeated, and the path through Ice Belt opens.

trophies.name: Heart of the Volcano
trophies.description: Defeat Phenoros at the Volcano Heart in Flare Pool.
trophies.verification: Phenoros is defeated, and the path through Flare Pool opens.

trophies.name: Core Breach
trophies.description: Defeat Omega Griever at Crystal Extraction in the Great Mines.
trophies.verification: Omega Griever is defeated, and the path through the Great Mines opens.

trophies.name: Reclaim the Mech
trophies.description: Defeat Varmis and reclaim the Galactic Federation mech in Sol Valley.
trophies.verification: Varmis is defeated, and the mech-rebuilding story event concludes.

trophies.name: Fully Awakened
trophies.description: Acquire every Psychic Power upgrade: Visor, Glove, Boots, Lasso, Boost Ball, Grapple, and Power Bomb.
trophies.verification: All Psychic Power upgrades appear unlocked in the abilities/inventory screen.

trophies.name: Scouted Out
trophies.description: Activate all six Scout Bots, one in each main area of Viewros.
trophies.verification: Every main area's Scout Bot has been activated, confirmed by the area map showing no remaining Scout Bot marker.

trophies.name: Full Bloom
trophies.description: Fill the Green Energy Crystal meter to its first full pass at the Altar of Legacy, unlocking the Legacy Suit.
trophies.verification: The Green Energy Crystal meter shown in the Mission menu reads full, and the Legacy Suit appears in the inventory.

trophies.name: The Pinnacle
trophies.description: Defeat Sylux in the final confrontation atop Chrono Tower.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene plays and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Fully Loaded
trophies.description: Reach full Item Percentage completion.
trophies.verification: The Item Percentage shown in the pause menu reads one hundred percent.

trophies.name: Living Archive
trophies.description: Reach full Logbook Scan completion.
trophies.verification: The Logbook menu's overall scan percentage reads one hundred percent.

trophies.name: Hardened Hunter
trophies.description: Complete the story with Hard difficulty selected.
trophies.verification: The Hard difficulty setting is chosen from the difficulty menu and remains active through the ending credits.

trophies.name: Beyond the Mask
trophies.description: Unlock the game's true ending by reaching full completion before your final confrontation.
trophies.verification: An alternate version of the ending cutscene and a secret epilogue scene play after the credits.

trophies.name: First Reading
trophies.description: Scan your first Logbook entry using the Psychic Visor.
trophies.verification: The scanned entry is confirmed added to the Logbook menu.

trophies.name: Galactic Legend
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.

trophies.name: Point and Click
trophies.description: Aim using Joy-Con 2 Mouse Mode for the first time. Requires a Nintendo Switch 2.
trophies.verification: The on-screen control-scheme indicator switches to the mouse-aim icon the moment the Joy-Con 2 is placed flat.

trophies.name: Tap In
trophies.description: Scan the Samus amiibo to unlock the once-per-day Energy Shield ability.
trophies.verification: The Energy Shield option appears in the abilities menu after scanning the amiibo.

trophies.name: Full Throttle
trophies.description: Scan the Samus & Vi-O-La amiibo to unlock the bike's distance odometer.
trophies.verification: The odometer stat appears in the Vi-O-La bike menu after scanning the amiibo.

trophies.name: Director's Cut
trophies.description: Scan the Sylux amiibo after completing the story to unlock early access to extended versions of cinematics shown only in fragments during the normal campaign.
trophies.verification: Previously fragmented cutscenes now play in their extended form after scanning the amiibo.

trophies.name: Cameo Call
trophies.description: Scan any other Metroid-series amiibo to trigger its bonus sound effect in the menu.
trophies.verification: A Metroid-themed sound effect plays immediately in the menu when the amiibo is scanned.
